runtime: Production Vite preview in embedded Chromium on Intel UHD / ANGLE D3D11

baseline.note: Isolated baseline Vite dev copy; only a diagnostic counter was added. Baseline fixed DPR differs from upgraded adaptive DPR. These are not matched-quality benchmarks.

method: Uninterrupted keyboard walking and M-key map transitions; no screenshots or DOM snapshots during the timed input sequence.

upgradedMobileFinal.method: Uninterrupted keyboard walking and M-key map transitions; no screenshots or DOM snapshots during the timed input sequence.

limitations: Two-second overlay averages are not a worst-frame guarantee. Walking/map worst frame: 33.5ms; complete trace worst: 50.1ms; worst window p95: 33.3ms.
Adaptive low-tier render resolution can fall to 0.7 DPR. Device scale was 3; effective render DPR is in the raw samples.
Baseline and final measurements differ in viewport, DPR and throttle and are not a matched-quality speed comparison.
The birthday UI trace is a separate intermediate functional-test trace, not the final walking/map acceptance benchmark.
